test_inputs.explanation: Values were extracted from the encoded filter segment in the final navigated URL. The base64-decoded filter contains customer_id[from]=10 and customer_id[to]=100, firstname=Alice, lastname=Smith, email=alice.smith@example.com, last_activity[from]=2026-02-01 00:00:00, last_activity[to]=2026-02-02 00:00:00, type=c and last_url=/checkout/cart. Fields not present in the URL (middle name, IP, session start times, grid id) are left empty.
